cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Associate for Clinical Education role at Stryker’s Peripheral Vascular division in EMEA. Your mission of making healthcare better resonates with me, and I would be glad to contribute to educational programs that help sales teams and healthcare professionals understand clinical evidence and treatment options.

My background is in digital marketing, content and web management, with a technical foundation from Applied Computer Science coursework at Karel de Grote Hogeschool. In my current roles at Episto and as a freelancer, I create SEO content, manage WordPress sites and coordinate projects for clients in Belgium and Türkiye. For majistraleczacilari.org.tr, a pharmacists’ association, I build and maintain a site with a consistent layout for around 600 member profiles. This taught me how to organise structured content carefully and keep information accurate and accessible. Earlier, at ViviDoctor, I worked on a healthcare web application, which gave me insight into clinical software and the importance of precision.

I am used to collaborating with different stakeholders, managing several projects at once and reporting on performance with Google Analytics and Search Console. I write clear English and enjoy turning complex topics into practical, engaging content. I am also comfortable working remotely and across cultures; I speak fluent English, native Turkish and some Dutch. I am flexible to travel 60% and eager to learn Stryker’s products, therapies and clinical data.

I would welcome the opportunity to support your clinical education initiatives, events and marketing materials. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
